name: Maralen
description: Maralen is a faerie duplicate of a Mornsong elf, created by Oona with a piece of her soul, who rebelled against her maker and became queen of the fae of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

summary.text: Maralen is a faerie duplicate of a Mornsong elf, created by Oona with a piece of her soul, who rebelled against her maker and became queen of the fae of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

bio.text: Oona killed the Mornsong elf Maralen and replaced her with a faerie duplicate, who gained unintended sentience.

bio.text: Maralen came to understand what she was and decided to defy Oona, and she took the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid.

bio.text: Forty years into her reign, Oko returned and exploited her fear of Oona, and Rhys struck her with a moonglove-poisoned blade.

timeline.summary: Ashling meets Rhys and Maralen, who is later revealed to be a fae duplicate bearing a piece of Oona's soul.
timeline.quote: Maralen was a fae duplicate

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen takes Ashling's elemental power, then betrays Brigid above Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Maralen snapped the Crescent from Brigid's neck and sent her falling.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen takes over the role of Queen of the Fae and restores the day/night cycle.
timeline.quote: Maralen had taken over the role of the Queen of Fae and restored the normal day/night cycle.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Oona's defeat, Maralen becomes the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: After Oona's defeat, Maralen became the new great faerie who rules from Glen Elendra and stewards the plane.

citation.text: "Faerie", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Festival of Tales they ambush Rhys in Kinsbaile; Rhys escapes and Gryffid is banished by Maralen's magic.
timeline.quote: was quickly banished from the battlefield by Maralen's magic.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona creates Maralen and instills her with a piece of her own soul.
timeline.quote: and instilled the imposter with a piece of her own soul

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen gains sentience and joins others to investigate Oona.
timeline.quote: banded together with others from across Lorwyn to investigate Oona and the effect she was having on the plane

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen becomes queen of the fae and binds Rhys to her, granting him immortality.
timeline.quote: Maralen took on the mantle of queen of the fae and bound herself to Rhys, granting him immortality

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona deploys the second heir, who will become Maralen, into Lorwyn as the Great Aurora nears.
timeline.quote: As the Great Aroura neared, Oona deployed this second heir into Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys meets Maralen, realizes the blast destroyed his horns, and lets her glamer him.
timeline.quote: Begrudgingly, Rhys allowed Maralen to bestow a glamer upon him that concealed his disfigurement.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Maralen and her faeries find Rosheen asleep, surrounded by dancing changelings.
timeline.quote: eventually came upon Rosheen, who was in a deep sleep

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen's plan pulls them into Rosheen's sleep, producing a shared dreamscape.
timeline.quote: Maralen devised a plan to pull them all into Rosheen’s sleep

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "The dream". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mistmeadow Jack, helped by Maralen, reroutes Rosheen away from Mistmeadow in exchange for her scroll.
timeline.quote: Rosheen's path was rerouted by Mistmeadow Jack

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "Awakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique abducts Maralen; Sygg reaches the Bosk with Rhys, Ashling and Brigid.
timeline.quote: Sygg took the company through the Dark Meanders

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The clique secretly spies on Rhys, Brigid and Maralen and reports to Oona.
timeline.quote: the trio was, in actuality, secretly spying on them and reporting their movements to Oona

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen sends the Vendilion clique on the gravest of tasks.
timeline.quote: Maralen sent Veesa, Endry, and Iliona—the Vendilion clique—on the gravest of tasks.

citation.text: Maralen of the Mornsong (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The clique lulls the party to sleep to read their thoughts but cannot breach Maralen's mind.
timeline.quote: He found her mind impregnably guarded and her secrets unreachable

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The clique whisks Maralen away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona.
timeline.quote: the siblings had whisked her away to Glen Elendra as a gift to their queen.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The clique learns Maralen is a faerie duplicate and begins to obey her.
timeline.quote: the clique was informed then of Maralen's origins as a faerie duplicate

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The fae overwhelm Gilt-Leaf forces pursuing Rhys, and Maralen makes Gryffid and the rangers vanish in fog.
timeline.quote: the rest of the Gilt-Leaf rangers and their leader Gryffid simply vanished in a haze of fog

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endry is sent to save Brigid and then guide the sapling while his sisters serve Maralen.
timeline.quote: Endry was dispatched to save Brigid Baeli from Gilt-Leaf hunters

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endry's mushroom ring lets Maralen divert energy from Ashling's ritual.
timeline.quote: Endry's mushroom faerie ring planted at the sapling's body allowed Maralen to divert a part of the energy from Ashling's ritual for herself.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
timeline.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
timeline.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reduced to a flamekin again, Ashling repents and helps Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: repented for her actions and tried to atone by helping Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
timeline.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
timeline.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Mistmeadow Gryffid sees fae carry Rhys away at Maralen's orders; Eidren sacrifices his life, and Gryffid brings his remains to Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: When Eidren sacrificed his life to protect Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oura proclaims herself queen by mimicking Oona.
timeline.quote: Oura proclaimed herself queen by mimicking Oona and gaining power through the collective belief of the fae.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Oura". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona creates two faerie siblings, the first of whom, Oko, is meant to rule Shadowmoor but rebels.
timeline.quote: This sibling rebelled and desired to rule in adherence to the natural cycle of the world

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona raises her younger daughter in seclusion and deprives her of warmth as a weapon against the coming aurora.
timeline.quote: The faerie was reared to be a weapon against the world that Oona feared would rise against her

citation.text: "Oona", section "The Shadowmoor prince". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with her half-formed daughter, who gains unintended sentience; the Vendilion bring her before Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona used her magic to kill an elf woman named Maralen and replaced her with her half-formed daughter

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen returns to her companions unaware she travels with Oona's spies, and conflict grows between her and Oona.
timeline.quote: the insuppressible autonomy of Maralen quickly led to unresolved conflict between the two

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
timeline.quote: She tried to take the elemental power of Ashling , but was thwarted by Maralen

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen and Oona fight in single combat above Cayr Ulios while their faerie armies clash.
timeline.quote: The two engaged in single combat as their Faerie armies clashed with each other.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental; Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
timeline.quote: Maralen took her place as queen of the fae as day returned to the plane.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen's offer of protection to Mistmeadow is repelled by Donal Alloway of Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Maralen offers Mistmeadow a protection, but is repelled by Donal Alloway

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Ode to Mistmeadow Jack, by Scott McGough and Cory J. Herndon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sygg helps Maralen and Brigid ambush Ashling; Maralen betrays him and keeps the Crescent.
timeline.quote: She kept the Crescent and united the power of two greater elementals, fire and water, in herself.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "After the Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves; Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her as their pact demanded.
timeline.quote: Rhys managed to catch up to Maralen and fatally struck her just as their pact had demanded of him.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals he orchestrated the ordeal, falsely convinced Maralen and Rhys of Oona's return, and cures his sister.
timeline.quote: Making amends, he cured his sister, and the two were able to reconcile.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen succeeded in temporarily stealing Ashling’s power for herself.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen deals Oona the killing blow with moonglove.
timeline.quote: Maralen dealt the killing blow using moonglove

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique, the elven monarchs and countless fae and elves perish; Ashling is freed of her madness and Maralen becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Maralen stood triumphant as the world's new queen of the fae.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen as she picks moonglove and replaces her with a faerie duplicate.
timeline.quote: An elf named Maralen was singled out and killed by Oona as she unsuspectingly picked moonglove .

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen meets Rhys in the Porringer Valley after his poison magic devastated the forest, and he agrees to take her toward Lys Alana.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, he agreed to take her to the Gilt-Leaf capital, Lys Alana .

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The duplicate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique takes Maralen directly to Oona after failing to read her mind.
timeline.quote: took her then directly to Oona

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After her audience with Oona, Maralen conjures fae magic to vanish Gilt-Leaf troops and watches Colfenor die and his sapling be born.
timeline.quote: She then went on to observe the fiery death of Colfenor and the subsequent birth of his sapling

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen comes to understand she is a fae duplicate created by Oona to carry her essence into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: She was a fae duplicate created by Oona to bear her memories and essence into the coming darkness of Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sharing Rosheen's dreamscape, Maralen decides to defy Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen awoke, freshly determined to defy the queen and greet the uncertain new world to do so.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen manipulates Endry into planting a faerie ring on the sapling to siphon the power of Ashling's ritual.
timeline.quote: She had manipulated Endry into planting a faerie ring of mushrooms on the sapling

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen obtains Rosheen's scroll after helping Jack Chierdagh divert a giant from Mistmeadow.
timeline.quote: The first, a scroll belonging to Rosheen, came into her possession after she and the siblings helped Jack Chierdagh divert the giant

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen is revealed to be a twin of Oona, defies her, and takes the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli.
timeline.quote: Later, she took the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli and challenged Oona to face her in a direct fight.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen gives Rhys the moonglove and instructs him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return.
timeline.quote: Maralen gave the moonglove to Rhys and instructed him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is granted eternal life until he can fulfill his oath.
timeline.quote: Rhys was granted eternal life until he was able to carry out his oath-sworn duty.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen gives Rhys a moonglove flower to use on her if Oona returns through her, and Rhys becomes unable to die until then.
timeline.quote: until that day came, Rhys could never die

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, and Rhys moves to strike her.
timeline.quote: He brandished his moonglow-tipped dagger against Maralen, but she escaped.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove; Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her.
timeline.quote: Rhys struck her with the moonglove poison, ensuring her death

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow; Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.
timeline.quote: Oko acquired a vial of dawnglow

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys declines a new oath, bids Maralen farewell, and fades into a shower of petals.
timeline.quote: his form faded beautifully into the wind as a shower of petals from across Lorwyn and Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: destroyed Oona by a combination of poison, fire, and water magic.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tamira and Sanar find Maralen turning into Oona; Tamira makes Rhys miss his attack and Maralen enlists their help.
timeline.quote: Tamira used probability magic to make him miss his attack and fall out a window

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group finds Ashling at the Stinkdrinker warren and sets out to track Isilu, but is halted by Brigid and the Shadowmoor kithkin.
timeline.quote: The four set out to track down Isilu

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn elves attack Isilu, kithkin join the fight, and Maralen and Tamira are poisoned with moonglow.
timeline.quote: Maralen and Tamira were injured with the deadly poison moonglow

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives with Kirol, and Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen steal the dawnglow vial, saving Maralen and Tamira.
timeline.quote: snuck into the elven lines, stole the vial, and brought it back, saving Maralen and Tamira's lives

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Forty years later Oko returns and Maralen fears Oona's return; the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
timeline.quote: The siblings, rejoined for the first time in decades, reconciled in the presence of Eirdu and Isilu

citation.text: "Oona", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and finds Maralen ruling Glen Elendra, plotting a trick that draws Strixhaven students there.
timeline.quote: he found Maralen ruling over Glen Elendra

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The students prematurely awaken Isilu, spreading Shadowmoor unnaturally.
timeline.quote: The students prematurely awakened Isilu

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she is Oko's sister, an avatar of Oona who rebelled and destroyed her.
timeline.quote: She then revealed that she was his sister, another avatar of Oona who had rebelled and destroyed her.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko protects Maralen and the students from elves, but Rhys wounds Maralen with a moonglow dagger.
timeline.quote: He was unable, however, to stop Maralen's retainer Rhys from wounding her

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko helps rout the elves, steals dawnglow and heals Maralen, then embraces her and reconsiders family.
timeline.quote: administered it to Maralen himself, which saved her from imminent death

citation.text: "Oko", section "Prodigal son". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories.
timeline.quote: she created a duplicate Maralen, a Mornsong elf, and instilled this duplicate with a piece of her soul
